result.summary: Found 3 issues: an untranslated placeholder key visible as section title, a category chip cut off at the screen edge, and a restaurant card truncated at the bottom edge of the visible viewport.

issues.description: Section title displays raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of translated text like 'Popular near you'
issues.suggestion: Fix the localization/translation binding so the correct string is rendered instead of the untranslated key

issues.description: The category filter row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is cut off at the right edge, hiding additional categories without a clear scroll indicator
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient edge or partial visible chip to indicate horizontal scrollability

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right edge of the screen, and its name text is truncated
issues.suggestion: Ensure card width and text truncation handle smaller screens gracefully, or add visual cue that more content is scrollable

issues.description: The pizza promo card at the bottom is abruptly cropped by the screen/navigation bar with no visible restaurant name or details
issues.suggestion: Adjust scroll container padding so cards aren't awkwardly cut off above the bottom navigation
